title: Removing a former technician's chip in Edit Line takes them off the line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by staff member B, with one approved line, line 1, so the line belongs to someone else's work order.
  • Have staff member A, a technician for this test (Parts Manager role, Time Clock on, Technician on, enrolled at the test location only), on line 1 of work order 1 added with Add Technician, with no time logged on the line, and then switch staff member A's Technician off (and save the warning), so they are on the line but no longer a technician.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open Edit Line for line 1.
  3. Click the X on staff member A's chip.
  4. Save the Edit Line window.
  5. Open Edit Line for line 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • Staff member A shows as a chip with an X.

Step 3:

  • Staff member A's chip is gone.

Step 4:

  • The window closes.

Step 5:

  • Staff member A is no longer on line 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 18 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R8: “Someone already on a line who is not offered per S3-R1 stays on the line. In the Edit Labor technician list they show grayed out, the same as a deactivated technician today; that list is in name order, so they appear among the others alphabetically, and they cannot be unticked there. In Edit Line they show as an ordinary chip that can be removed with its X, unless they have logged time on the line, in which case the chip shows the existing lock and "This technician has logged time on the line and cannot be removed.", as today. Saving a line's technicians in Edit Line keeps a person who is no longer a technician on the line unless the user removed them. As today, saving also drops a person from the line who has a labor entry on the work order but is not in the location's Time Clock list (deactivated, Time Clock off, on the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, or not enrolled at the location) and has no time logged on that line; such a person who is on the line only through Add Technician, with no labor entry, stays.”

From: Chris Ward's answers, Google Sheet "Technician Toggle – questions for Chris Ward (2 Nov 2026)", https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nLKkgSgmtqCYu4eu15_9xN38ml32tDnJls42PPq_A4M, column E, answered 2 Nov 2026 (po-answers-2026-11-02/ANSWERS-Chris-Ward-2026-11-02.md), read 2 Nov 2026

  • Answer 6 (question 6): “6. (a) As the PRD says: an ordinary chip, not grayed out, removable with its X, with the lock if they have logged time on the line. Grayed out means deactivated, and this person isn't deactivated. I'll fix the page 6 note in the design.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793640819-ff4d, read 2 Nov 2026: page "6 Technician dropdowns on a work order", picture "Add Technician on a line" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p6-04-after-add-technician-on-a-line.png

The design's own words:

  • “Not offered: Parth Fadadu follows Nikola Milosevic. Add Labor uses the same list.”
  • “Anyone already on a line who is not a technician any more stays on it. In Edit Line they show as an ordinary chip, not grayed out, removable with its X; the lock shows instead if they logged time on the line. Grayed out still means a deactivated technician, as today.”

Ruled: Chris answered question 6 (a), as the PRD: an ordinary chip, not grayed out; the design's page 6 note now says the same (register TT-D02, PO-RULED).
